name: Xanadu Quantum Codebook
description: The Xanadu Quantum Codebook is a free, interactive introduction to quantum computing built on the PennyLane framework. It teaches quantum algorithms through a structured sequence of coding exercises (codercises) that run directly in the browser. The codebook covers topics from single-qubit gates to advanced quantum algorithms with immediate feedback on solutions.

news.title: Xanadu Quantum Codebook repository archived
news.excerpt: The Xanadu-Quantum-Codebook repository was archived by the owner on January 16, 2025 and is now read-only.
